messages:
Ana: Heads up — finalizing ScaleBench run-through next Tue 10am PT. Need ops checklist for reg page -> Zoom -> recordings -> post-event lead routing.
jared_ops: I can handle Zoom config. Confirm: cloud recording + host local? we should enable alternative hosts for cohosts. Also enable live transcript (auto-caption) and generate SRT.
maria_growth: Reg page copy done in doc: https://docs.google.com/placeholder — please make sure CTA is "Register — seats limited". Also we want two hidden utm params: utm_source=benchmark and utm_campaign=scalebench_march.
devon_prod: For recording split we will: 1) cloud recording (active speaker + gallery) 2) SRT from live transcript 3) extract clips via the clip pipeline. Need naming convention: scalebench_<env>_<YYYYMMDD>_<segment>.mp4
Ana: @jared_ops can you toggle "record active speaker, record gallery view separately"? We want separate files for clip editing.
jared_ops: Zoom settings done: cloud recording -> record active speaker and gallery, transcription enabled, alternative hosts: @devon_prod, @ana.marketing. Passcode on join disabled for friction, waiting room ON. I'll post screenshot config in this thread.
deploy-bot: Recording archive created: /zoom-archives/scalebench/2141593600/raw_cloud/ (will copy to GCS after meeting).
maria_growth: Post-event email flow: 1) immediate replay email w/in 30m w/ link to MP4 + SRT 2) 24hr nurture with 2 short clips 3) 7d case study ask. Lead routing rules: mark source=benchmark_webinar, assign owner: product_marketing queue.
devon_prod: Routing logic: If form answer "Are you evaluating inference infra?" = yes -> assign to sales_eng; else -> nurture stream. HubSpot mapping property: product_interest -> inference_bench. Also add lead score +5 if >10 attendees from same domain.
Ana: Who's hosting live Q&A? @maria_growth + @devon_prod? Also need a backup recorder in case cloud fails — @jared_ops will record local on laptop as fallback.
jared_ops: Affirmative. I'll join 30m early, run test recording, and keep local fallback at /home/jared/zoom_fallback/scalebench_local.mp4
maria_growth: Can ops tag timeline markers during event? We'll ask an internal note-taker to drop timestamps in chat; devon will extract segments using those markers.
Ana: Quick snippet for clip naming/metadata to add to runbook:
```
filename: scalebench_prod_20260325_01_intro.mp4
utm: utm_source=benchmark&utm_campaign=scalebench_march
hubspot: lifecycle=lead; product_interest=inference_bench
```
devon_prod: I'll prepare the clip-extract script and a one-page runbook for the post-event handoff. Will drop in the shared doc by EOD Friday.
Ana: Final checklist: reg page live, zoom config confirmed, co-hosts assigned, recording automation hooked into deploy-bot, email templates queued, lead routing test complete. Anyone missing items?
devon_prod: I'll test the HubSpot form mapping and routing with a sandbox lead and report back.
Ana: Great — thanks all :thumbsup: We'll reconfirm on Monday morning.
